secondary_analysis.admission_rule: At W7 first seal algorithms and every selection choice. Only after that seal may bounded original-data schema qualification proceed. After qualification and before any external prediction, append the cohort/family seal for the admitted comparisons. Preserve all failed cohorts and reasons. secondary_analysis.pooling_rule: Report cohort effects separately. Do not pool nominal counts into independent N without identity crosswalk; Pan2023/Pan2025 possible overlap grouped in sensitivity analysis.
secondary_analysis.seed_rule: Five fixed pipelines; average per-participant pipeline outcomes before participant-level inference. Seeds/sessions/trials are not additional independent participants.
